review: DAENEM Staff Portal Autos and Logistics authorization-boundary review

findings.summary: Granular Autos and Logistics dashboards delegated to broad base dashboards, exposing sibling-submodule counts and financial metrics.
findings.correction: Dashboards are permission-composed and query only authorized submodules.

findings.summary: Delegated Logistics drivers could enumerate unassigned company trips and shipments, receive trip and shipment financial fields, and target unassigned records for trip writes.
findings.correction: Driver reads are assignment scoped, financial fields are withheld, POD/expense/fuel/trip mutations require the assigned trip, and denials are neutral.

findings.summary: Autos and Logistics references, joins and follow-up mutations did not consistently repeat authoritative company predicates.
findings.correction: Referenced vehicles, leads, customers, drivers, shipments and trips are validated inside the module company; joins and follow-up mutations repeat company scope.

reviewer.result: PASS for the bounded Autos and Logistics security change; authenticated V45 browser acceptance remains separately pending.
